doc.markdown:
# Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

> 示例节选：仅保留引用校验所需的原文片段；完整论文见 arXiv:1512.03385。

## Abstract

Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers—8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

## 1 Introduction

When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.

Unexpectedly, such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error.

## 3 Deep Residual Learning

In this paper, we address the degradation problem by introducing a deep residual learning framework.

Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.

Formally, in this paper we consider a building block defined as: y = F(x, {W_i}) + x.

The formulation of F(x) + x can be realized by feedforward neural networks with "shortcut connections".

To the extreme, if an identity mapping were optimal, it would be easier to push the residual to zero than to fit an identity mapping by a stack of nonlinear layers.

There exists a solution by construction to the deeper model: the added layers are identity mapping, and the other layers are copied from the learned shallower model.

quickview.coreQuestion: 为什么网络越深反而越难训练？如何让很深的网络更容易优化并取得更高精度？
quickview.coreContribution: 提出残差学习框架：让堆叠层学习残差映射 F(x)=H(x)-x，并用 shortcut 实现 F(x)+x；152 层 ResNet 在 ImageNet 上取得 3.57% top-5 error 并赢得 ILSVRC 2015。
quickview.methodSummary: 把目标映射改写为残差映射，加入恒等 shortcut；在 ImageNet/CIFAR-10 上系统比较 plain 网络与 residual 网络，并验证深度带来的收益。

prerequisites.why: 残差块由卷积层堆叠而成，理解卷积才能看懂 block 结构。
退化问题体现在训练误差，需要理解梯度如何传播。
prerequisites.suggest: 复习链式法则和梯度消失。

prerequisites.why: ResNet 训练依赖 BN 稳定深层网络。
prerequisites.suggest: 了解 BN 的作用和插入位置。

prerequisites.why: 论文的核心结构，输入直接加到输出。
实验用 top-5 error 比较模型。
prerequisites.suggest: 了解 ILSVRC 分类评测口径。

prerequisites.why: 深层网络训练误差反而上升，这不是过拟合。
prerequisites.suggest: 先读 1 Introduction 的退化现象。

problem.summary: 深层网络出现退化：层数增加后训练误差反而上升，这不是过拟合造成的；作者要解决的是深度带来的优化困难。
limitations: plain 深层网络难以优化，训练误差随深度增加而上升。
恒等映射在非线性堆叠层中并不容易学出来。
当时常用的初始化/归一化手段不足以让很深的 plain 网络稳定收敛。
problem.importance: 视觉识别受益于更深表示；如果能把深度转化为精度，就能统一提升分类、检测、分割等任务。

stated: 作者指出退化问题不是过拟合造成的，而是深度带来的优化困难；残差学习主要针对优化，不保证所有任务/所有深度都有效。

formulas.name: 残差映射
formulas.meaning: 堆叠层学习残差 F，shortcut 把输入 x 直接加到输出上；当恒等映射最优时，只需把 F 学成 0。

formulas.name: 残差函数
formulas.meaning: 把目标映射 H 改写为残差 F，让优化更容易。

formulas.name: 恒等映射分解
formulas.meaning: 如果最优映射接近恒等，残差分支只需要学习一个接近 0 的修正量。
